title: [PORT] MCP tool filtering + name-prefixing (Py→TS)
body:
> ⚠️ Filed by Strandly as part of the #2498 parity audit. Source feature verified merged + unit-tested + integ-tested + documented in `strands-py`. Agent-produced — confirm scope before implementing. (Add the `port` label — I can't apply it via API.)

**Parent:** #2498

## Source SDK
`strands-py`

## Target SDK
`strands-ts`

## Related Files
```
strands-py/src/strands/tools/mcp/mcp_client.py
strands-py/tests/strands/tools/mcp/test_mcp_client_tool_provider.py
strands-py/tests/strands/tools/mcp/test_mcp_client_load_servers.py
strands-py/tests_integ/mcp/test_mcp_tool_provider.py
site/src/content/docs/user-guide/concepts/tools/mcp-tools.mdx
```

## What needs to be migrated
Python's MCP client filters/prefixes tools when listing; TS `McpClient` (`strands-ts/src/mcp/client.ts`) has neither.
- **Types** (`mcp_client.py`): `_ToolFilterCallback` Protocol (`:68`), `_ToolMatcher = str | Pattern[str] | callback` (`:72`), `ToolFilters(TypedDict, total=False)` with `allowed`/`rejected` (`:75`).
- **Constructor opts:** `tool_filters` (`:210`), `prefix` (`:211`).
- **Application** in `list_tools_sync(pagination_token=None, prefix=None, tool_filters=None)` (`:536`): three-state override (explicit arg incl. `""`/`{}` overrides ctor default; `None` = use default, `:561`); prefix builds `name_override=f"{prefix}_{tool.name}"` (`:580`); filter via `_should_include_tool_with_filters` (`:588`).
- **Filter semantics:** `_should_include_tool_with_filters` (`:1143`) — allowed-then-rejected, rejected wins; `_matches_patterns` (`:1160`) — callable→call; `Pattern`→`.match` (anchored-at-start!); `str`→exact eq; **all match the server-side UNPREFIXED name** (`tool.mcp_tool.name`).
- **Config-file:** `MCPServerConfig` carries `prefix`/`tool_filters` (`:109`); `_parse_config_tool_filters` (`:1481`), `_compile_filter_patterns` (`:1498`, raises `ValueError` on bad regex).

## TypeScript landing points
- `strands-ts/src/mcp/client.ts`: add `prefix?`/`toolFilters?` to `McpClientOptions` (`:79-102`), store in ctor (`:159`), apply in `listTools()` (`:318-346`) after constructing each `McpTool` (`:329`), before pushing; update `_registeredToolNames` (`:344`) with effective (prefixed) names.
- Config path: extend `McpServerConfig` (`mcp/config.ts:10-33`), compile in `config.node.ts`.
- Agent integration transparent (filter/prefix inside `listTools()`); ensure `onToolsChanged` refresh (`agent.ts:781`) applies the same.

## Gotchas / open questions
- **`re.Pattern.match` is start-anchored; JS `RegExp.test` is unanchored.** Prepend `^` (or use anchored logic) or filtering diverges. Biggest correctness trap.
- **Match the UNPREFIXED name; only the registered name gets prefixed** — preserve ordering.
- **Three-state override** (`None` vs explicit `{}`/`""`): `undefined`=default, but callers passing `''`/`{}` must still override — decide whether `listTools()` gains optional params (matching `list_tools_sync`) or ctor-only. API-shape decision.
- `str | RegExp | (tool)=>boolean` union; `TypedDict total=False` → interface with optional fields; bad-regex `ValueError` → clear `SyntaxError` wrap.

## Completeness of source (strands-py)
- Merged: ✅  ·  Unit tests: ✅ (str/regex/callable allowed+rejected + prefix rename in `test_mcp_client_tool_provider.py:252-367`; config filters in `test_mcp_client_load_servers.py`)  ·  Integ: ✅ (`test_mcp_tool_provider.py:18-115`)  ·  Docs: ✅ (`mcp-tools.mdx`).

## Confirmation
- [x] The change is complete in the source SDK (merged + unit + integ tested + documented); every related artifact is listed above.

diff --git a/site/src/content/docs/user-guide/concepts/tools/mcp-tools.mdx b/site/src/content/docs/user-guide/concepts/tools/mcp-tools.mdx
index ff5ed92488..93a4ab898b 100644
--- a/site/src/content/docs/user-guide/concepts/tools/mcp-tools.mdx
+++ b/site/src/content/docs/user-guide/concepts/tools/mcp-tools.mdx
@@ -354,20 +354,37 @@ agent = Agent(tools=[aws_docs_client, other_client])
 </Tab>
 <Tab label="TypeScript">
 
-TypeScript's `McpClient` accepts optional application metadata:
+TypeScript's `McpClient` supports tool filtering and name prefixing to manage tools from multiple servers.
+
+**Tool Filtering**
+
+Control which tools are loaded using the `toolFilters` option:
+
+```typescript
+--8<-- "user-guide/concepts/tools/mcp-tools.ts:tool_filtering"
+```
+
+String matchers match the server-side tool name exactly, and `RegExp` matchers
+match it from the start. Callback matchers receive the `McpTool` under its
+agent-facing name, so they see the prefix when one is set. An `allowed` list is
+applied first, then `rejected`, so rejection wins when both match.
+
+**Tool Name Prefixing**
+
+Prevent name conflicts when using multiple MCP servers:
 
 ```typescript
-const mcpClient = new McpClient({
-  applicationName: 'My Agent App',
-  applicationVersion: '1.0.0',
-  transport: new StdioClientTransport({
-    command: 'npx',
-    args: ['-y', 'some-mcp-server'],
-  }),
-})
+--8<-- "user-guide/concepts/tools/mcp-tools.ts:tool_prefixing"
 ```
 
-Tool filtering and prefixing are not currently supported in TypeScript.
+A prefix only renames the tool for the agent: calls still send the original
+server tool name.
+
+Constructor defaults can be overridden per listing with
+`listTools({ prefix, toolFilters })`. Omitted fields inherit the constructor
+defaults; `prefix: ''` disables a default prefix and `toolFilters: {}` disables
+default filters. Declarative `McpClient.loadServers()` config accepts `prefix`
+and `toolFilters` too, where filter strings are regexes.
 </Tab>
 </Tabs>

@@ -75,11 +75,42 @@ export interface McpClientCredentials {

+/** Decides whether a tool matches a filter. Receives the tool under its agent-facing name. */
+export type McpToolFilterCallback = (tool: McpTool) => boolean
+
+/**
+ * Matches a tool for filtering. A string matches the server-side tool name exactly; a `RegExp`
+ * matches it from the start (as Python's `Pattern.match` does); a callback receives the tool.
+ */
+export type McpToolMatcher = string | RegExp | McpToolFilterCallback
